task_title: CI recovery: observable dispatch decision logging

plan_review.notes: stdout-into-run-log medium confirmed sound over artifact/step-summary/comment. Adopted reviewer fixes: (1) intent-based taskComment planned/dry-run/not-applicable, not 'posted'; (2) contract explicitly scoped to runs reaching a final dispatch-table decision (startup/ownership/opt-out guards already log their own reason lines and never summon copilot); (3) stage-specific determinant inputs added, attempt renamed stateAttempt, fingerprint/mode/terminalPass included; (4) snapshot {row,ctx,pass} captured in-loop instead of recomputing; (5) topology integration tests (early skip + terminal non-dispatch + dispatch). Dropped redundant taskSkipReason since action carries the skip reason.

rounds.notes: Finding 1 (Medium): terminal records lacked an explicit cap/ceiling field required by the task. Fixed by adding staleRetryCeilingReached, re-derived from ctx.stallAction===release (no new plumbing, no behavior change). Finding 2 (Medium): trigger/stateTrigger logged as unbounded free-form strings. Fixed via sanitizeTrigger (coerce-to-string + 120-char truncation); raw value deliberately preserved (not enum-collapsed) so anomalous triggers stay diagnosable. 4 new unit tests, test:guards 1816/0.
